svg.aria-label: F01b — the same fit over the observed interval only
svg.desc: Scatter plot of p/Z against cumulative gas produced for the base-case water-drive scenario over the observed interval only, from 0 to 55.0 Bscf. Forty-nine observed points are drawn as circles joined by a solid line, with the volumetric straight-line fit as a long-dashed line. The vertical axis is truncated to the observed range, from about 2163 to 4404 psia, so that departures of a few psia between the observations and the fit are visible; the observations lie above the fit at both ends and below it in the middle. The extrapolation to the fitted x-intercept is deliberately not drawn in this view. Full values in the data table below the figure.
